snippet.title: Blueprint Bob | Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Get Blueprint Bob: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3215120/Blueprint_Bob/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=release_date_trailer&utm_medium=bio

Join our discord: https://discord.gg/zr5z6qKxED

Blueprint Bob Soundtrack: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8xr8W7tvERI

The GMTK Game Jam 2024 Winner Blueprint Bob has been revamped and is releasing as a full-fledged game on Steam August 13th! 

Stack, twist and build structures for Bob to climb and beat all 42 levels across three worlds.

Compete with other players and your Steam friends for the highest scores on the leaderboards for each level.

Create your own levels and send them to other players or try other their creations via our discord: https://discord.gg/zr5z6qKxED

Save your solutions and if you get stuck on a level try asking a friend for help and load theirs!

00:00 - Release Date Trailer
00:39 - Level Editor
00:54 - Copy and save your solutions
01:08 - Releasing August 18th 2025 on Steam
